Definition
[parabolic heat-kernel cutoff] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0361 1. ch16:16.40\group Localized Entropy

For $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$ define \[ \varphi _{(x_0,t_0),\rho }(y,t)=\left(1- \frac{d(x_0,y)^2+2n(t-t_0)}{\rho ^2}\right)_+. \] Then $(\partial _t-\Delta )\varphi _{(x_0,t_0),\rho }\le 0$ distributionally.
